dialect.detail: Micro Focus Visual COBOL / COBOL for Eclipse; uses cblt-fileexist-buf, cblt-rtncode, cblt-x1-compx, CBL_CHECK_FILE_EXIST, CBL-GET-OS-INFO, cblte-osi-* data names, comp-x — all Micro Focus runtime extensions

purpose.domain_detail: Auto-setup/locale detection utility that determines the correct locale/country directory (MFOCALDIR) for a Micro Focus COBOL application by checking environment variables and OS country codes
purpose.summary: The program checks the MFOCALDIR environment variable for a valid directory; if not found, it queries the OS for country/locale information (Windows country code or Unix LC_MESSAGES) to determine the appropriate locale directory and sets MFOCALDIR, MFOCALCP, and MFOCALHDIR environment variables accordingly. It returns AUTOSETUP-OK on success or AUTOSETUP-FAILED on failure.

notable_features: cblt-* and cblte-* Micro Focus data types
COPY with missing copybook (missingcopyexample.cpy — intentional example of missing copybook error)
Environment variable manipulation via DISPLAY/ACCEPT with ENVIRONMENT-NAME/ENVIRONMENT-VALUE
Country code to locale mapping (Windows country IDs)
verdict.notes: The IDENTIFICATION DIVISION is absent (only PROGRAM-ID present without the division header), which is valid in some Micro Focus dialects. The file contains an intentional missing copybook reference (missingcopyexample.cpy) with a comment explaining it is an example. The duplicate WHEN 351 entries (mapped to pt, fi, tw) appear to be a bug. This looks like part of a real Micro Focus COBOL application's setup/localization infrastructure.
